groups.name: Money path / wallet / reward systems
groups.summary: Merged work touching value movement, wallet payloads, fee logic, reward claims, and contract semantics.

items.title: feat: add event faucet claim codes
items.technical_point: Adds a claim-code workflow for event faucet distribution, including claim state handling and focused validation coverage.
items.why_it_matters: Reward systems need explicit claim paths so event payouts are auditable instead of relying on ambiguous manual handling.

items.title: feat: add EIP-1559 fee market helpers
items.technical_point: Introduces deterministic base-fee and fee-market helper logic compatible with EIP-1559-style accounting.
items.why_it_matters: Fee logic sits directly on the money path; helpers make future fee changes testable and less ad hoc.

items.title: fix: enforce signed transfer nonce ordering
items.technical_point: Rejects signed wallet transfers with stale nonces while preserving exact duplicate replay behavior.
items.why_it_matters: Wallet transfers need replay resistance and monotonic ordering to protect balance integrity.

items.title: feat(wallet): add multisig proposal support
items.technical_point: Adds multisig proposal primitives for wallet-side approval workflows.
items.why_it_matters: Multi-party wallet operations need explicit proposal state instead of informal off-chain coordination.

items.title: feat: add RustChain ERC-721 NFT contract
items.technical_point: Implements ERC-721-style ownership, approvals, transfers, minter controls, and metadata URI behavior.
items.why_it_matters: Contract surfaces need standard ownership and approval semantics before downstream integrations rely on them.

items.title: fix: align Python SDK signed transfer payload
items.technical_point: Moves the Python SDK to the live signed-transfer endpoint and canonical payload fields expected by server validation.
items.why_it_matters: SDK drift on wallet payloads can break real transfers or teach users the wrong transaction shape.

groups.name: Consensus / validator / chain invariants
groups.summary: Merged work around block production, validator duties, slashing, randomness, attestation, ordering, and chain safety metrics.

items.title: feat: add reorg resistance metrics
items.technical_point: Adds metrics for observing reorg-resistance behavior at the chain level.
items.why_it_matters: Consensus health needs measurable signals before operators can reason about reorg risk.

items.title: feat: add validator attestation effectiveness metrics
items.technical_point: Adds attestation effectiveness metrics for validator performance analysis.
items.why_it_matters: Validator quality needs observable effectiveness, not just raw participation counts.

items.title: feat: add slashing penalty core
items.technical_point: Adds core slashing penalty calculation and state handling.
items.why_it_matters: Validator security economics require deterministic penalty behavior before enforcement can be trusted.

items.title: fix: order pending txs by admission time
items.technical_point: Makes pending transaction ordering deterministic by admission time.
items.why_it_matters: Mempool ordering affects fairness, replay analysis, and test reproducibility.

items.title: feat: add slasher evidence core
items.technical_point: Adds side-effect-free slasher evidence primitives and tests.
items.why_it_matters: Penalty systems need auditable evidence models before they mutate validator state.

items.title: feat: add data custody proof checks
items.technical_point: Adds deterministic data custody challenge and proof verification helpers.
items.why_it_matters: Availability and custody claims need proof checks that validators can test and reproduce.

items.title: feat: add block-bound randomness beacon
items.technical_point: Adds randomness beacon helpers bound to block context.
items.why_it_matters: Randomness needs deterministic chain context so it is usable in tests and resistant to accidental drift.

items.title: feat: add weighted fork-choice duty balancing
items.technical_point: Adds deterministic weighted fallback duty balancing for fork-choice related scheduling.
items.why_it_matters: Validator duty selection needs predictable balancing when multiple candidates are available.

items.title: fix: serialize block saves with template production
items.technical_point: Serializes block persistence with template production to avoid state races.
items.why_it_matters: Block production needs atomicity between generated templates and saved chain state.

items.title: perf: parallelize block transaction signature checks
items.technical_point: Parallelizes signature verification for larger blocks while keeping small blocks on the serial path.
items.why_it_matters: Signature validation is a consensus hot path; throughput wins must preserve correctness and avoid overhead for small blocks.

items.title: feat: add sync committee rotation tracker
items.technical_point: Tracks sync committee rotation state and related metrics.
items.why_it_matters: Committee rotation is a protocol scheduling surface where observability reduces operator blind spots.

items.title: Add epoch transition analytics to reward dashboard
items.technical_point: Adds epoch transition analytics to reward dashboard reporting.
items.why_it_matters: Reward dashboards need epoch transition visibility to explain validator payout behavior.

items.title: feat: add proposer duty calendar
items.technical_point: Adds proposer duty calendar views for epoch scheduling.
items.why_it_matters: Operators need predictable proposer duty visibility to debug missed or upcoming duties.

items.title: feat: add attestation pool monitoring
items.technical_point: Adds monitoring around attestation pool state.
items.why_it_matters: Attestation pipelines need pool-level visibility to diagnose validator participation and queue health.

items.title: feat: add validator performance dashboard metrics
items.technical_point: Adds dashboard metrics for validator performance and health.
items.why_it_matters: Validator systems need operational feedback loops so weak performance is visible before it becomes consensus risk.

groups.name: State, sync, client, and storage APIs
groups.summary: Merged work that adds safer state abstractions, client helpers, diffs, and storage maintenance boundaries.

items.title: feat(sync): add swappable state providers
items.technical_point: Adds a StateProvider boundary with SQLite, in-memory, and fallback implementations.
items.why_it_matters: Sync code becomes easier to test and evolve when storage is abstracted behind a narrow provider interface.

items.title: Add opt-in SQLite state pruning utility
items.technical_point: Adds an explicit pruning utility for SQLite state maintenance.
items.why_it_matters: State databases need bounded maintenance paths that are opt-in and testable rather than hidden cleanup.

items.title: feat: add state diff API
items.technical_point: Adds an API for comparing and reporting state differences.
items.why_it_matters: Diff visibility makes chain state debugging and sync verification more concrete.

items.title: feat: add lightweight SPV client helpers
items.technical_point: Adds lightweight SPV client helper primitives.
items.why_it_matters: Client-side verification needs small, reusable helpers rather than forcing every consumer through full-node paths.

groups.name: Explorer, bridge, identity, and user-facing observability
groups.summary: Merged work that exposes chain state, bridge history, agent metadata, and dashboards through clearer user-visible surfaces.

items.title: feat: add explorer block filters
items.technical_point: Adds explorer filters for proposer/miner, time range, transaction counts, and gas usage.
items.why_it_matters: Explorer users need precise filtering to inspect chain behavior instead of scanning raw block lists.

items.title: fix: resolve Sophia Beacon Atlas profile
items.technical_point: Adds a public redacted Beacon Atlas profile endpoint and resolves Sophia through current and legacy IDs.
items.why_it_matters: Agent metadata links must live-resolve; stale discovery endpoints are high-signal user trust failures.

items.title: fix: use live hall of fame endpoints
items.technical_point: Moves Hall of Fame behavior onto live endpoint paths.
items.why_it_matters: Public leaderboards and proof pages need to reflect live system state, not stale or demo routes.

items.title: [FEAT] Add mempool visualization to explorer dashboard
items.technical_point: Adds mempool visualization to the explorer dashboard.
items.why_it_matters: Mempool visibility helps operators and users understand pending transaction pressure and ordering.

items.title: feat: add bridge dashboard history metrics
items.technical_point: Adds bridge dashboard history metrics.
items.why_it_matters: Bridge flows are trust boundaries; history metrics make transfer status and operator behavior easier to audit.

groups.name: Network, P2P, and node operations
groups.summary: Merged work that hardens peer negotiation, node observability, NAT operation, and propagation memory.

items.title: fix: bound block propagation seen cache
items.technical_point: Bounds the seen-cache used for block propagation.
items.why_it_matters: Unbounded propagation memory can become an operational reliability issue on long-running nodes.

items.title: fix: add UPnP peer announcement for NAT nodes
items.technical_point: Adds UPnP peer announcement support for nodes behind NAT.
items.why_it_matters: Peer discovery and reachability matter for decentralized network participation.

items.title: Add TLS-valid P2P Prometheus metrics
items.technical_point: Adds Prometheus scraping for P2P node health, peer count, attestations, epochs, and scrape freshness.
items.why_it_matters: P2P health needs TLS-valid operational metrics so node issues can be detected outside the node process.

items.title: fix: negotiate P2P handshake parameters
items.technical_point: Negotiates compatible protocol version, k-bucket size, ping interval, and timeout on peer handshakes.
items.why_it_matters: Peers with slightly different settings need compatibility negotiation instead of brittle connection failures.

groups.name: Runtime, CI, and public API hardening
groups.summary: Merged work that reduces public abuse surface, import-time failures, and raw internal error exposure.

items.title: fix: rate limit core RPC API
items.technical_point: Adds a thread-safe sliding-window limiter before GET routing and POST body parsing.
items.why_it_matters: Public RPC endpoints need request pressure controls before expensive parsing or route execution.

items.title: fix: keep GPU fingerprint import safe on CPU CI
items.technical_point: Defers PyTorch/CUDA checks until GPU fingerprinting actually runs.
items.why_it_matters: CPU-only CI should be able to import modules and run unrelated tests without GPU dependency failures.

items.title: fix: redact agent economy internal errors
items.technical_point: Replaces raw exception responses in Agent Economy write routes with generic 500 payloads while logging server details.
items.why_it_matters: Public write endpoints should not leak internal exception data to clients.

groups.name: Documentation, localization, and contributor path quality
groups.summary: Merged work that removes stale links, broken relative paths, and contributor onboarding drift.

items.title: docs: fix Dutch README contributing link
items.technical_point: Fixes the Dutch README contribution link so it resolves back to the root contribution guide.
items.why_it_matters: Localized docs must preserve contributor paths or new contributors get routed into dead links.

items.title: docs: fix installation walkthrough recording link
items.technical_point: Points the installation walkthrough to the checked-in asciinema recording instead of a missing generated GIF.
items.why_it_matters: Install docs should link to artifacts that exist in the repo and can be reviewed.

items.title: docs: add README language index
items.technical_point: Adds a compact language index for README translations.
items.why_it_matters: A language index makes translated entry points discoverable without burying them in prose.

items.title: docs: fix Chinese mining guide relative links
items.technical_point: Fixes broken relative links in the Chinese mining guide.
items.why_it_matters: Mining onboarding docs need working navigation for non-English contributors and operators.

items.title: Fix zh-CN API reference links
items.technical_point: Fixes repository-relative links in the Chinese API reference.
items.why_it_matters: API docs lose trust quickly when translated references point to the wrong path.

items.title: docs: fix installation walkthrough checkout path
items.technical_point: Corrects a stale repository checkout path in the installation walkthrough recording command.
items.why_it_matters: Install commands must match the actual repository or first-run setup fails immediately.

items.title: docs: link AI contribution policy
items.technical_point: Links the AI contribution onboarding policy from CONTRIBUTING.md.
items.why_it_matters: AI-assisted contributors need visible repo-specific rules before opening PRs.

items.title: fix: remove BOM from Postman collection
items.technical_point: Removes a leading UTF-8 BOM from the Postman collection JSON.
items.why_it_matters: Strict JSON tooling can fail before parsing if the collection starts with a BOM byte sequence.

groups.name: External transferable proof
groups.summary: Merged work outside RustChain showing that the same framework can transfer when a target repo has real review activity.

items.title: test: cover CLI price and dedupe helpers
items.technical_point: Adds direct helper tests for price formatting and row deduplication behavior.
items.why_it_matters: Shows the Druid loop can produce maintainer-approved, focused test coverage outside RustChain.
